cautions: Path 060A under the Rocca Laubert is steeper and rougher at first, a mountain path (T2): take it slowly and keep your dog close.
Climbing crags above path 060A: watch for falling stones and climbers’ gear.
The first 100 m are on the provincial road through Talucco: keep your dog on a short lead there.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Path 060A under the Rocca Laubert is ste: Il sentiero 060A sotto la Rocca Laubert è all’inizio più ripido e sconnesso, un sentiero di montagna (T2): procedi piano e tieni il cane vicino.
textIt.Climbing crags above path 060A: watch fo: Pareti di arrampicata sopra il sentiero 060A: attenzione a sassi che cadono e all’attrezzatura degli arrampicatori.
textIt.The first 100 m are on the provincial ro: I primi 100 m sono sulla strada provinciale al Talucco: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
